class.name: SuperposSchema
class.brief_description: Native schema authoring and bounded callback-free bake.
class.description: Compiled into the EGP engine through its native Superpos module. Full-width unsigned values use signed opaque Variant bits in GDScript and unsigned native metadata in generated C# and C++ bindings.

method.name: bake
method.description: Validates and sorts the authored field descriptors, then returns a Dictionary containing [code]error[/code]. On success it also contains [code]manifest[/code], [code]fingerprint[/code], [code skip-lint]schema_id[/code], [code skip-lint]revision[/code] and [code]state_bytes[/code]. Duplicate IDs and invalid codec bounds are rejected. Baking does not configure a session.

method.name: get_fingerprint
method.description: Returns the hexadecimal SHA-256 fingerprint of the baked schema manifest, or an empty String when baking fails. Use [method bake] to inspect the error.

members.member: Authored canonical field descriptors. Baking rejects null entries, invalid descriptors and duplicate field IDs.
Nonzero unsigned revision of the authored schema manifest. Changing it changes the baked manifest fingerprint.
Nonzero unsigned schema identifier. All participants must provision a compatible manifest.
